description: Agent Oversight: submit the work items being handed to agents (outcome, agent, owner and owner type where known), optional known people with load limits, known agent names and a load limit per owner. The signed brief maps the accountable person for each outcome and flags unowned items, items owned by an agent or a group rather than a person, and owners carrying more than the stated load. A supplied handover package is wever_handover-check. Verdict unowned_outcomes, agent_owned_outcomes, owners_overloaded or all_owned. POST /api/ownership-map-brief. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-oversight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-oversight/.
